summary.text: Tom Takubo is a Republican state senator from West Virginia who has represented District 17 since December 2014 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A pulmonary, critical care and sleep physician, he served as Senate majority leader from November 2018 to January 2025.

paragraphs.text: Tom Takubo received a bachelor's degree in chemistry from Marshall University in 1995 and a doctorate of osteopathy from the West Virginia School of Osteopathic Medicine in 1999.
From 2004 to 2007 he was a pulmonary and critical care fellow at East Tennessee State University, and he then co-founded Pulmonary Associates of Charleston.
Takubo first ran for public office in 2014, winning the District 17 Senate seat with 52 percent of the vote, and was re-elected in 2018 and 2022.
He chaired the Senate Committee on Economic Development from 2015 to 2016 and the Committee on Health and Human Resources from 2017 to 2018.
He became majority leader on November 26, 2018, and held the post until January 8, 2025.
Takubo sponsored a bill prohibiting smoking in cars with children under 16, which Governor Jim Justice signed into law in 2024.
In the 2025-2026 session he serves on the Finance, Health and Human Resources, and Pensions committees.
